verdict.rationale: Warp's open-source announcement says it is shipping a settings file that gives users programmatic control over settings and easy portability between devices. That is a first-party capability on the story's axis, but it comes from a single launch-blog line. Its depth is unproven: the evidence does not say whether the file covers the terminal's full configuration or how it fits a dotfiles workflow. missing for 10: confirmation that the settings file is plain text and covers all configuration (themes, keybindings, prompts, appearance), docs on file location/format for dotfiles management, evidence of cross-machine sync behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
